svg.title: Comprehensive Capability Assessment — annular radar
svg.desc: Six original score dimensions, two products. Inner circle is 0, outer circle is 100. Smooth contours interpolate observed axis scores without introducing between-axis extrema.
svg.metadata: {"source_payload": {"name": "radar_chart", "x": 290, "y": 124, "width": 499.2, "height": 515, "type": "radarFilled", "categories": ["Performance", "Security", "Usability", "Pricing", "Support", "Innovation"], "series": [{"name": "Product A", "values": [90, 85, 75, 70, 80, 88]}, {"name": "Product B", "values": [75, 90, 85, 80, 70, 65]}], "style": {"colors": ["#4F46E5", "#F43F5E"]}}, "visualization": {"type": "annular-radar", "categories": ["Performance", "Security", "Usability", "Pricing", "Support", "Innovation"], "series": [{"name": "Product A", "values": [90, 85, 75, 70, 80, 88]}, {"name": "Product B", "values": [75, 90, 85, 80, 70, 65]}], "center": [440, 406], "inner_radius": 70, "outer_radius": 232, "score_domain": [0, 100], "radial_mapping": "r = 70 + 1.62 * score", "angle_order": "clockwise from 12 oclock, equally spaced 60 degrees", "interpolation": "periodic monotone radial cubic Hermite; decorative between-axis interpolation, not extra observations", "native_replacement": false, "variable_size_bubbles": false}, "default_palette": {"id": "lavender-spring", "name": "科研配色｜薰紫春庭", "colors": ["#8F86B4", "#B7ACCD", "#DBCCE2", "#D6A3B1", "#E8CCAB", "#A8C3B5"], "series_colors": ["#8F86B4", "#D6A3B1"], "stroke_colors": ["#8F86B4", "#AA818C"]}}
